title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix Club on 1966-12-01

ai_review.summary: Cleaned‑up soundboard capture of the Dec 1 1966 Matrix show with high energy and a standout Alice D. Millionaire, though some track‑order quirks remain.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that has had the original tape hiss removed, but listeners note a slight loss of high‑end sparkle. Musically the band is in good form, delivering an early‑Dead set highlighted by a fiery Alice D. Millionaire; a few reviewers point out confusing ordering of Lindy/Dancin' in the Street/Me & My Uncle.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and the cleaned‑up audio, while a few note technical shortcomings (high‑end loss) and metadata/track‑order issues; overall the show is strong and the recording solid enough for a >4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original tape hiss has been removed in this source, but reviewers mention a loss of high‑end detail after cleaning; overall clarity is solid with no major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set early‑Dead setlist featuring many 1966 staples; some listeners note that Lindy, Dancin' in the Street and Me & My Uncle are mixed up, causing a confusing track order.
